GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 470.8 (3 Dec 45) GD
(SCAPIN - 385)
3 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Experiment of Remodelled Bulldozers.
1. References:
a. Your C.L.O. No 806(2.3) subject as above dated 1 December 1945.
b. Our Memo file AG 470.8 (10 Nov 45) GD subject: "Remodelling Japanese Army Tanks", dated 10 November 1945.
2. There is no objection to carrying out the tests mentioned in reference 1a. However, it is desired that arrangements for the time and place be made directly with the Commanding General Eighth U. S. Army as directed by Par 5 of reference 1b above.
3. Copies of your memorandum have been forwarded to the Commanding General Eighth U. S. Army.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
